The terminal state does not convert missing evidence into negative ruler evidence.","The local disposition audit and research ledger materially disagree, especially for Chapter 1B; this remains a credible handoff blocker.","Gateway pages, indexes, homepages, broad synthesis locators, bundled claims, and repeated source-family coverage reduce defensible evidence counts but are recoverable cleanup or extraction defects, not automatic absence of evidence.","Official claims are overrepresented across the dossier. Independent checks exist in several chapters but are insufficient for all principal bias risks.","The notebook does not document fully balanced favorable-and-adverse searching across every selected lens.","Researcher-written syntheses and negative findings must not be treated as independent evidence, exculpatory proof, score guidance, or ranking advice.","No chapter is passed as fully adequate for fair presentation of governing conduct, contrary material, and attribution across its selected lenses."],"needs_continuation":false,"reviewer_summary":"Terminal no-search review completed for all eight selected chapters. Chapter 7B remains the most attribution-sensitive; Chapter 1B retains the clearest local-audit contradiction. No continuation is requested because permitted research rounds are exhausted.
